# Wavyroom

> Wavyroom makes factory-built backyard studios and outdoor saunas for homes in
> the United States and Canada. Each unit is cut, insulated and finished in our
> own factory in Korea, shipped flat, and assembled on the customer's property in
> three days or less. Built by Spacewavy Co., Ltd., which has delivered more than
> 300 houses since 2019.

## Products

- **The Studio** — 119 sq ft (8'3" × 14'5" / 2,513 × 4,403 mm). From $24,900 USD.
  A backyard office, playroom, yoga room or prayer room. Charred timber exterior,
  shingle and zinc roof, insulated walls, floor and roof, LVT flooring, interior
  walls painted on site. In Canada this model is built at 89 sq ft.
- **The Sauna** — 89 sq ft overall (8'2" × 10'10" / 2,500 × 3,300 mm), 9'10" tall,
  with a 7'3" × 7'3" cedar-lined interior. From $27,900 USD.
  Two-tier cedar bench, Harvia Cilindro PC90E 9 kW electric heater with stones and
  digital controls included, picture window, deck and outdoor bench.

## How it works

1. Panels are cut, insulated and finished at the Wavyroom factory in Korea.
2. Ocean freight to a Los Angeles warehouse (United States) or a Port Coquitlam,
   British Columbia warehouse (Canada). Included in the price.
3. Local delivery to the customer's address — quoted separately.
4. Assembly by a licensed local general contractor, three days or less on site.
   No foundation poured, no framing cut on site.

## Permits

In California a detached accessory structure of 120 sq ft or less is exempt from a
building permit. In British Columbia the threshold is 10 m² (about 108 sq ft);
the Canadian models are built to sit under it. These are detached accessory
buildings, not dwelling units and not ADUs, and local rules often restrict
sleeping, cooking, plumbing or rental use. Wavyroom does not certify exemption —
the customer's municipality decides, and the local contractor files any permit.

## Not included in the price

Local delivery from the warehouse, backyard assembly, on-site electrical work by a
licensed electrician, a concrete pad or foundation mat, sales tax (US) or GST and
PST (Canada), and any municipal permit fee.
